basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of San Francisco's desirable Cow Hollow neighborhood, 3035 Webster Street is a charming 7-unit building with solid in-place cash flow, featuring a unit mix of two one-bedroom apartments and five bright studio units. Two units will be delivered vacant, which is ideal for leasing at market rates. Additionally, 4 of the five garages are unoccupied, offering significant potential for extra income or secure tenant parking. Each unit showcases quintessential San Francisco charm, highlighted by bay windows, original hardwood floors, and abundant natural light that creates an inviting atmosphere. Spacious eat-in kitchens and large windows add to the appeal, making these units especially attractive to prospective tenants.
